messages:
marta_design: quick mock for a compact invoke 'swap' flow in the playground — putting a small inline button in the run row instead of a modal. screenshot: https://redwood.mock/s/compact-swap.png ryan_devex: good call to avoid modals. quick Q: how should schema diffs surface when you swap tools? tiny inline diff or a separate panel? marta_design: thinking tiny inline diff (one-line summary) + chevron to expand full signature. keeps run history density. copy below. leo_pm: important: keep the audit trail. even if we let people swap inline, run history needs to show original tool + swapped tool + timestamp. maybe a subtle tag with tooltip. tori_accessibility: accessibility nit: the inline swap needs an accessible name that explains the change, e.g., `button aria-label=\"Change tool for this invocation\"`. also `aria-haspopup` on the chevron if it expands into more content. ensure keyboard focus moves into expanded area. sam_engineer: implementation note: we can reuse the invocation-inspector panel code. example aria snippet we can plug in: ```html
function foo(bar: string) -> object
``` aya_research: perf note: inline diffs mean we lazily fetch the function schema on expand — fine. caching by function id avoids repeated loads on quick toggles. also check bundle size if we include diff renderer. marta_design: thanks — will update mock and copy. copy proposals: replace verb "Swap tool" with "Change tool" to reduce ambiguity, and use "View signature" instead of "Show schema" (shorter + clearer). ryan_devex: +1 on "Change tool". UX suggestion: after changing tool, show a non-blocking toast: \"Tool changed — rerun to apply\" instead of auto re-run. gives control back to user. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for playground/ui-compact-swap — build 4823
